tldr: For binary fixed potential outcomes and fixed reports with at most \(K\) discrepant entries across both arms, the unrestricted original-record minimax game has an exact finite reduction attained by fair independent assignment. At \(K=\lfloor\lambda n^{1/3}\rfloor\), the proved Robin transfer gives \(V(n,K)=n^{-1}-E_{\mathrm R}(\lambda)n^{-4/3}+O_L(n^{-3/2})\), uniformly on each compact budget-coordinate interval. The benchmark improvement \(C_{\mathrm R}(\lambda)=E_{\mathrm R}(\lambda)+\lambda^2\) is positive and strictly decreasing, while the sharp robustification price relative to the published clean binary class is \(C_{\mathrm A}-E_{\mathrm R}(\lambda)\), strictly increasing from zero. Matching finite rational lower and observable upper certificates and a terminating certified root evaluator deliver this coefficient without a surviving budget-floor phase. The precision benchmark applies prospectively to a complete-report experiment under an externally defensible both-potential-arm error cap.
gap: Clean unrestricted minimax theory observes the target outcomes directly.
